quotes: Saving The SC48 From Overheating And Scrap

forensic_summary.intervention: I executed a comprehensive 16-configuration 'Design of Experiments' thermal matrix to empirically define the Safe Operating Area (SOA) for the embedded architecture. I identified that the 3U form factor was non-viable due to high impedance. I engineered a transition to a 4U 'Lung' chassis and implemented 'MacGyver' flow guidance hardware (Die-Cut LDPE fan ducts) to physically channel high-velocity air directly over the CPU, bypassing the thermal blockage.
forensic_summary.result: The 4U side-intake architecture stabilized the internal temperature rise on the critical Left side (CPU) to 22.6°C, providing 13.8°C of thermal headroom over the failed config. This permanently eliminated the shutdown risk while maintaining the flagship 'rack-less' aesthetic.
forensic_summary.trigger: During pre-production 'capali FOH' stress testing, the embedded CPU (Kontron 986LCD-M) breached the critical 75°C threshold. The system logs captured the catastrophic event: 'CPU temperature is 75C, system shutdowned'. The 'rack-less' mandate forced high-density components into a sealed environment where Industrial Design imposed a strict 'Cooling done from the sides' limitation, creating a lethal heat trap.

isomorphics.hardware_point: High-density embedded PC components in a sealed 3U chassis triggered a catastrophic 75°C 'Kill Event' system shutdown during stress tests. Expanded chassis volume to 4U, engineered an 'Origami Spine' for structural support, and utilized custom LDPE fan ducts to force high-velocity 12V air directly into the thermal core.
isomorphics.label: Dissipating Heat
isomorphics.principle: High-density processing requires directed flow architecture to prevent system suffocation.
isomorphics.software_point: Managing Token Density / Complexity — When LLM context windows become oversaturated (thermal trap), deploy structured context expansion (4U volume) and specialized routing agents (fan ducts) to direct computational focus precisely where needed.
